placement: After all topic modules and before the results page. Every question can be skipped.
purpose: None of these answers is ever used to compute a person's positions. They are used to (1) validate the axes (known-groups and vote checks), (2) test that items mean the same thing across groups (DIF), (3) weight pilot data to the national population, and (4) let people compare themselves with others like them if they choose.
privacy: No names, emails, IP addresses or exact birth dates are collected. Age is collected in brackets. Answers are stored only with a random response ID. People under 18 can see their results, but their answers are not stored for research.
intro_text: These last questions are about you. They're optional, and they never change your results. We use them to check that the quiz works the same way for everyone.

items.stem: Which of these best describes your political views?
items.note: Ideology labels are allowed here, and only here, because this question measures self-labeling for validation. It comes after all position questions so labels can't prime answers.
